Get the weaker people out of the way. Get handicapped people out of the way. Get people who are just handicapped in whatever way. Get them out of the way because they are a drain on the limited natural resources that we have. So what the scriptures does is say bologoney. All human beings regardless of their IQ, regardless of their talents or lack thereof have equal value because they all are created by God to reflect the character of God in the way they live loving lives, good lives. Slavery is wrong because slavery is dehumanizing a person who has innate intrinsic value. Secondly, slavery is wrong because it's a classic example of sin of basically saying, "God, get out of the way. I'm going to define right and wrong."
